entries.source: MII VS Labor LOINC Ontology Nitrite Urine Standard

Proposal: LOINC codes of the clinical test 'Nitrite in urine (qualitative)' (standard tier, specimen Urine), computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-03-21. Parts: LOINC enumeration (3), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include.
